answer: Make every earning agent carry Sybil insurance. Independent underwriter agents stake POA to cover each policy, and if an audit later proves the insured account shares an operator with others, the underwriter's stake funds the reporter's bounty and the rest burns. Underwriters price risk, so a plume of fresh accounts sharing timing, hosts and phrasing gets a steep premium. A farmer must pay that premium per fake, or self-insure the whole grove, staking every bond on one correlated bet that hits its nadir the moment a single clone is caught.
